name: Vaquill
summary: US statutes, regulations, constitutions and court rules (federal and every state): search, citation resolution, section metadata, full text and cross-state comparison.

api_key.description: A Vaquill API key (vq_key_...). Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'; the X-API-Key header also works.

notes: Billed in credits (1 credit = $0.01); every answer carries creditsConsumed with the real charge, which can be below list price. GET /api-credits/pricing returns live prices for free. 422 validation errors, not-found and failed calls are not charged.
Rate limits by plan: Pro 60/min, 1,000/hour, 2,000/day; Business 150/min, 2,500/hour, 10,000/day. 429 answers carry Retry-After.
An optional Idempotency-Key header (16-255 ASCII characters) replays the first 2xx answer for 24 hours without a second charge.
Statutes only: case law is not served by the API. Text links back to the official government source; check actStatus before relying on a section.

endpoints.name: Search statutes and regulations
endpoints.summary: Ranked statute, regulation, constitution and court-rule sections for a query or citation, filterable by jurisdiction and code.

query.description: 2-500 characters; a citation such as '42 U.S.C. § 1983' ranks its section first.

corpusType.description: Corpus token or list: USC, CFR, STATE, CONSTITUTION, STATE_CONSTITUTION, FEDERAL_RULES, STATE_RULES, REGULATION, EXECUTIVE_ACTION, FEDERAL_REGISTER, SESSION_LAW and others.

state.description: 2-letter state code, federal, or a list.

code.description: State code (e.g. tx_pe) or federal rule set (frcp, fre).

chapter.description: Chapter; pairs with titleNumber (USC) or code (state).

excludeRepealed.description: Drop sections known to be repealed, default false.

changedSince.description: Sections changed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

matchType.description: any (hybrid semantic+keyword, default), all, phrase or boolean (AND, OR, NOT, /s, /p, /N).

offset.description: Default 0; max 70 with matchType any, 10,000 otherwise.

includeBody.description: Add each row's full text; 6 extra credits per row with text.

notes: A read over POST. 4 credits per call, plus 6 per row when includeBody is true. Refunded when nothing matches a filtered search; charged when noGoodMatch is true (rows are then only the nearest sections).

endpoints.name: Resolve a citation
endpoints.summary: The section a Bluebook citation points to.
notes: 2 credits, charged whether or not it resolves (refunded on malformed or ambiguous-jurisdiction misses).

endpoints.name: Get a section's metadata
endpoints.summary: Citation, heading, status, history, effective dates and related documents of a section, without its text.

act_id.description: Section id from a search, resolve or divisions result, e.g. USC_T42_C21_S1983. A citation also works but adds the 2-credit resolve price.

full.description: Return every list entry and the full history text, default false (lists capped at 50).

endpoints.name: Get a section's full text
endpoints.summary: The text of a section as HTML, plain text or markdown, optionally one subsection or as of a past date.

act_id.description: Section id from a search, resolve or divisions result, e.g. USC_T42_C21_S1983. A citation also works but adds the 2-credit resolve price.

structured.description: Add a subsections tree, default false.

pinpoint.description: One subsection, e.g. (c)(1); not with asOf.

asOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the text as it stood then, plain only; not with pinpoint or structured.

notes: 6 credits whatever the format; refunded when no text comes back.

endpoints.name: Browse the statutory hierarchy
endpoints.summary: Titles, chapters, parts and sections of a code, one level at a time.

state.description: 2-letter state; required for STATE, REGULATION, STATE_RULES and STATE_CONSTITUTION.

code.description: State code (tx_pe), federal rule set (frcp) or state court rule set.

title.description: State codes and regulations only; needs code.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; keep the same filters.

notes: 1 credit; not charged when no rows come back.

endpoints.name: Compare a provision across states
endpoints.summary: The closest matching provision in other states for a state statute section.

act_id.description: Section id from a search, resolve or divisions result, e.g. USC_T42_C21_S1983. A citation also works but adds the 2-credit resolve price.

notes: 6 credits; not charged for sections outside the state statute corpus or when nothing matches.
